text:
Ana: Ok folks — need to lock webinar topic by EOD. Proposed: 'Inference Economics: Practical knobs for latency & cost'. Short abstract below. Thoughts?

Jake: I like the core, but can we make it more customer-facing? e.g. 'How to serve LLMs without breaking the bank' — clearer headline.

Ana: Good call. Mei, can you draft a 3–4 line abstract we can use on the event page?

Mei: Draft incoming — 1st pass: 'Join Redwood Inference engineers for a hands-on session covering practical techniques to reduce inference cost and improve latency. We’ll show batching, caching, and graceful fallbacks with real benchmark takeaways and a live demo.' Will tighten.

Sam: Speakers — Rhea (APAC infra), Marco (runtime), Ana (PM). Can Rhea do live demo? she may be traveling next week.

Lina: If Rhea's out, Marco can cover the demo. Recommend we script a failover demo so it's deterministic.

Ana: Rehearsals — propose two dry runs: tech check (30m) + full run (60m). Dates: Wed/Thu next week. ops-bot to propose times.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: suggested slots posted — tech check 2026-04-14 10:00 UTC; full run 2026-04-16 16:00 UTC. Please ✅/❌. :calendar:

Jake: Quick note on lead routing: inbound signups -> SFDC web_leads queue; add tag `webinar:inference`. Can we auto-assign to AE rotation if form field `demo_ok` = true?

Lina: Yes — SDRs already have an AE-rotation rule. I'll add `demo_ok` as a trigger and confirm field name. Also we should include a CTA in follow-up email for booking demos.

Mei: Marketing assets checklist: slides deck, 1-pager benchmark summary, demo script (step-by-step). I'll own slides + benchmark summary. Jake you own landing copy and confirmation email.

Ana: Run-of-show (draft):
```
1) Welcome & intros — 5m
2) Benchmark narrative — 10m
3) Live demo (with KV-cache + fallback) — 20m
4) Customer Q&A — 15m
5) CTA, next steps, close — 10m
```
Need timing tweaks but this is the backbone.

Sam: Add fallback plan: if live demo stalls, switch to pre-recorded demo clip (2m) then continue. Where will the clip live and who presses it?

Marco: Pre-recorded clip stored in GDrive: /Marketing/Webinars/pre-recordings. I'll keep a local copy on laptop and a USB fallback. Person to press: Marco or Sam depending on ops lead.

Ana: Action items recap: Mei — abstract v1 by EOD; Jake — landing copy by tomorrow; ops-bot — book rehearsals; Marco — prep fallback clip and local copy. Everyone else, thumbs if aligned. :thumbsup:

Jake: :thumbsup: I'll also add GA event tag + UTM params for paid promos.

Mei: Uploaded abstract v1 to drive (link redacted). Will iterate with Ana.

Lina: I'll follow up with SDRs on routing rules and AE triage flow. Also can A/B test two subject lines if marketing wants.

Ana: Thanks — if no objections I’ll confirm speakers and finalize the event page tonight. Ping me for any conflicts.
